Dockerfile: sh -c 'if command -v hadolint >/dev/null 2>&1; then hadolint "$@"; else echo "warn: hadolint not installed — skipping (brew install hadolint to enable)"; fi' _
*.{yml,yaml}: sh -c 'if command -v yamllint >/dev/null 2>&1; then yamllint -c .yamllint.yaml "$@"; else echo "warn: yamllint not installed — skipping (brew install yamllint to enable)"; fi' _
